================================================================================
⚡ QUICK START (5 MINUTES)
================================================================================

STEP 1: Configure GitHub Secrets (2 minutes)
-------------------------------------------
1. Go to: Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API
2. Copy: Project URL and service_role key
3. Go to: GitHub Repo → Settings → Secrets → Actions
4. Add:
   - SUPABASE_URL = [your project URL]
   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = [your service role key]

STEP 2: Validate Setup (1 minute)
---------------------------------
Run: ./.github/validate-setup.sh

STEP 3: Test Pipeline (2 minutes)
---------------------------------
npm run db:new
npm run db:migrate
git add supabase/migrations/
git commit -m "test: GitHub Actions"
git push origin main

Watch at: GitHub → Actions tab 🚀

================================================================================
🎯 WHAT THIS DOES
================================================================================

BEFORE (Manual):                    AFTER (Automated):
-----------------                   -------------------
1. Create migration                 1. Create migration
2. SSH into server                  2. Push to main
3. Run manually                     3. ✨ Done automatically!
4. Hope it works                       - Tests connection
5. Debug if fails                      - Runs migration
6. Document                            - Logs everything
                                       - Notifies on failure
                                       - Creates summary

Result: Faster, safer, consistent deployments

================================================================================
🛡️ SECURITY
================================================================================

✅ All credentials in GitHub Secrets (encrypted)
✅ Never exposed in logs
✅ Not in code or commits
✅ Access controlled by GitHub
✅ Validation checks for .env in .gitignore

Your .env file stays local - never committed!

================================================================================
🐛 TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================

Workflow doesn't trigger?
→ Check migrations changed, pushed to main, Actions enabled

"Missing secrets" error?
→ Add both secrets in Settings → Secrets → Actions

"Connection failed"?
→ Verify Supabase active, credentials correct, using service_role key

Need more help?
→ See GITHUB_ACTIONS_SETUP.md troubleshooting section

================================================================================
💡 PRO TIPS
================================================================================

DO:
✅ Test locally first (npm run db:migrate)
✅ Use descriptive migration names
✅ Include rollback instructions
✅ Keep migrations small
✅ Review deployment summaries
✅ Monitor Actions tab

DON'T:
❌ Skip local testing
❌ Commit .env files
❌ Use anon key (use service_role)
❌ Run destructive migrations without backup
❌ Merge without review
